referenceSources.description:
A bright red Renault 19 16V navigates a slalom course marked by traffic cones on a flat asphalt test track. The driver, seated in the five‑door hatchback, demonstrates the car’s direct steering and firm suspension as it leans slightly through the turn. The clear daylight and open surroundings emphasize the car’s sporty character and 1990s design cues.

Under the hood, the 1.764‑liter F7P engine delivers 140 hp without a catalytic converter (135 hp with one), revving smoothly up to 7,000 rpm. This naturally aspirated 16‑valve powerplant replaced Renault’s earlier turbocharged hot models, offering a distinctive power delivery. The test car’s solid build quality, precise gearbox, and front‑wheel‑drive layout combine to create a confident driving experience, despite a somewhat firm ride on uneven surfaces.
